name: @usualmail/design
description: Usual Mail's design tokens, and the CSS, Swift values, fonts and icons generated from them.

scripts.check:swift: cd swift && swift build && swift test
scripts.check:ios: cd swift && xcodebuild -quiet -scheme UsualMailDesign -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .build/xcode CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
